tools.name: test
tools.description: Run the tests of requirements and tests, record the results in .rq/E<n> <slug>.md, and report their results (`test`)

targets.description: Requirement or test files, folders, .md names, or ids such as R10 or T12

recurse.description: Also run the tests of every requirement below a requirement target

name.description: The slug of the results file; the targets by default

ai.description: The AI agent and model, [claude|copilot][:<model>], e.g. claude:fable, for instruction steps; the first installed agent by default. An empty string gives the option without a value

project.description: The project the call works in: the path of its rq.json, or of the folder that has it, absolute or relative to /pkg

tools.name: coverage

recurse.description: Also check every requirement below a requirement target

project.description: The project the call works in: the path of its rq.json, or of the folder that has it, absolute or relative to /pkg

path.description: A requirement file, or a folder of requirements; the requirements folder by default
